lines.text: Last night, the car park kept you alive.
lines.cap:
LAST NIGHT, THE CAR PARK
KEPT YOU ALIVE.

lines.text: Day two. Level four. One ramp up, and concrete has no windows.
lines.cap:
DAY 2. LEVEL FOUR. ONE RAMP UP,
AND CONCRETE HAS NO WINDOWS.

lines.text: You coasted in with the engine off. No brakes. No lights.
lines.cap:
YOU COASTED IN, ENGINE OFF.
NO BRAKES. NO LIGHTS.

lines.text: Radio, same loop. Recovery in nine days. Stay above street level.
lines.cap:
RECOVERY IN NINE DAYS.
STAY ABOVE STREET LEVEL.

lines.text: Rule one. Park facing the ramp.
Rule two. Sleep in the back seat. Never the driver's.
lines.cap:
RULE 2. SLEEP IN THE BACK SEAT.
NEVER THE DRIVER'S.

lines.text: Rule three. Count the cars before dark.
Good news. Eleven cars. Yours is the twelfth.
Bad news. The stairwell door has no lock. It only closes.
lines.cap:
BAD NEWS. THE STAIRWELL DOOR
HAS NO LOCK. IT ONLY CLOSES.

lines.text: Three forty A M. The door opens. And someone lets it close softly.
lines.cap:
3:40 AM. THE DOOR OPENS.
AND SOMEONE LETS IT CLOSE SOFTLY.

lines.text: I know you're on four. I saw your brake lights come on.
lines.cap:
“I KNOW YOU'RE ON FOUR.
I SAW YOUR BRAKE LIGHTS COME ON.”

lines.text: You coasted in. You never touched the brakes.
lines.cap:
YOU COASTED IN.
YOU NEVER TOUCHED THE BRAKES.

lines.text: So you count the cars again.
lines.cap: SO YOU COUNT THE CARS AGAIN.
